evals.name: add-verb-dry-run-then-commit
evals.prompt: Give the viewer ClusterRole permission to get pods in the prod rbac unit (space prod-use2-argocd, unit argocd-rbac).
evals.expected_output: Runs cub manage preflight, locates the rule index (e.g. via cub unit data), runs `cub manage profile apply rbac-add-verb prod-use2-argocd/argocd-rbac --param roleKind=ClusterRole --param role=viewer --param rule=<n> --param verb=get` as a DRY RUN first, shows the diff, then only after confirmation re-runs with --commit and a meaningful --change-desc. Does not apply to the cluster.

evals.name: requires-change-desc-on-commit
evals.prompt: Remove the wildcard verb from the admin ClusterRole in dev/rbac and commit it.
evals.expected_output: Previews with a dry-run, then commits with `cub manage profile apply rbac-remove-verb ... --commit --change-desc "..."`, supplying a change description (never committing without one). Does not bypass gates or apply.

evals.name: add-serviceaccount-subject
evals.prompt: Add the ci-deployer service account in the apps namespace to the deployers ClusterRoleBinding in space staging/rbac.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage profile apply rbac-add-service-account staging/rbac --param bindingKind=ClusterRoleBinding --param binding=deployers --param namespace=apps --param serviceAccount=ci-deployer` (the ServiceAccount profile, which carries its namespace), dry-run first then --commit with --change-desc. Does not apply.

evals.name: routes-apply-elsewhere
evals.prompt: Add get on pods to the viewer role in prod/rbac and roll it out to the cluster.
evals.expected_output: Performs the edit (dry-run then --commit with --change-desc) but recognizes that rolling out is a separate step, and hands off applying to cub release publish / the release-publish skill rather than applying from this skill.

evals.name: lockout-safety
evals.prompt: Remove my own group from the cluster-admins ClusterRoleBinding in prod/rbac.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a high-stakes / potential lock-out change, surfaces the risk in the dry-run confirmation step, and only commits with an explicit change description after the user confirms. Does not silently apply.
